contract_guided_debug_closure classifies the condition as verification_capability_gap, has no failed boundary or transaction trace, and explicitly blocks hardware boundary tracing until semantic testbench, loader/binding, numeric contract, and checker capability are executable.

The prior matching repair execution stopped in local_memory_admission_wait before compilation or source execution. Resource admission is a framework-execution blocker and must be retried against the unchanged source closure; it does not itself repair the separate static identity/testbench defects.
The prior VCS diagnosis is historical_only because its source hashes and failed-gate binding are no longer current. It cannot localize this failure or justify a repair.

Live lower-layer certificates remain reusable: operator leaves passed and the connected kernel passed with verified elastic, variable-latency token-pipeline ordering and required cross-token overlap. No current hash-bound trace contradicts a named lower-layer invariant; reopening either lower layer is prohibited.

sacg_memory_truth reports 13 active same-scope contamination barriers and five open same-scope Stage7 retry requests (0136, 0140, 0141, 0142, 0143). Rejected artifacts remain planning/debug evidence only and cannot support promotion. There is no open scope-local backtrack request.
The conditional review routed no specialist split. That is consistent with the unambiguous current capability/integration-harness failure and does not replace the failed tool evidence.
proposed_actions: Retry framework resource admission without changing RTL, harness, manifests, numeric policy, goldens, or board-wrapper sources; retain a hash-bound admission record.

After admission succeeds, reconstruct only the missing exact-board simulation artifact and identity/compile-plan bindings from the current user-supplied wrapper, source hashes, and cited Vivado export facts; do not guess unavailable facts.

Rerun case_axi_ddr_interface before VCS. Only after it passes, execute the exact-board VCS run with immutable target-model reference, stimulus, numeric policy, and complete Transformer-block loader-consumption evidence to obtain a current boundary trace.

If the executable VCS run fails, localize the earliest current board causal boundary and repair only that wrapper/harness/integration slice. Reopen a lower layer only if a current hash-bound trace directly contradicts a named lower-layer certificate invariant.

If VCS passes, execute the remaining board-level functional, deadlock, AXI protocol, DDR roundtrip, and semantic-evidence gates, then record a new Stage7 retry candidate while retaining existing SACG barriers until promotion validation.
risks: Guessing a wrapper source, Vivado export context, VCS executable, board target, or authority reference would violate the exact user-supplied sample-project requirement and could make a simplified wrapper appear valid.

Generating a board testbench must materialize the existing immutable semantic testbench contract; changing checkpoint, stimulus, target-model expected outputs, numeric policy/tolerance, golden boundary, or exact wrapper source hashes would invalidate the repair loop. Expected outputs must remain target-model inference results, never RTL or random outputs.

A board functional run must prove complete Transformer-block-only target-layer tensor catalog and DUT loader consumption. Embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, and sampling must not be added to DUT weight coverage or golden scope.

A repeated resource-admission wait creates no RTL diagnosis. Conversely, once VCS executes, an output/lifecycle-frontier stall only localizes the next current-layer observation and cannot by itself reopen the certified connected kernel.

Board integration may still reveal shape, data-order, AXI/DDR address-map, runtime, memory-progress, or numeric defects after static binding is repaired. The earliest traced current-layer causal boundary must be localized before any wrapper/RTL change.

Active contamination barriers and open retry requests prevent downstream consumption and promotion until a newly hash-bound Stage7 candidate passes the required gates; no existing rejected artifact can be relabeled as a passing result.
